quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite press release: Expansion of Production Capacity for Semiconductor (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sumitomo Bakelite will add production lines for semiconductor encapsulation materials (epoxy molding compounds) at Sumitomo Bakelite (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., expanding its production capacity in China by approximately 30%, with commercial operation of the expanded capacity planned for around December 2028. Company: the expansion meets growing demand for semiconductors in China driven by the rapid proliferation of generative AI; demand for semiconductors for AI data centers (GPUs, memory, power semiconductors) has increased dramatically. It previously added lines at the current plant in March 2022 and started operations at a new plant in 2025; it produces encapsulation materials in Japan, China, Singapore, Taiwan and Belgium.
quarterly_data.figure: China encapsulant capacity +approximately 30%; expanded capacity around December 2028
